artworks.title: Falls Station, Niagara
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a train in motion on tracks in the foreground. In the background, there is a waterfall with cascading water captured in swift brushstrokes. The horizon is partially hidden by mist and distant land formations. The drawing style is sketch-like with pencil marks creating texture. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of black and gray capturing the natural and man-made elements in the scene.

artworks.title: The Balloon-Shed
artworks.description: The image depicts a grassy field with a large aircraft hangar in the center. The horizon is low with distant low structures and terrain visible. The hangar has a wide entrance, leading to a dark interior. The artwork is created with graphite, showing sketchy pencil strokes for texture. The sky has small aircraft in flight drawn with quick strokes. The color palette is monochrome with shades of gray and black. Grounded biplanes are scattered throughout the field.

artworks.title: Building Engines for the Allies
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a industrial scene with locomotives and workers in a train workshop or factory. There are multiple locomotives in different stages of assembly or repair, and many workers are shown working. The setting is detailed, showcasing the teamwork and industrious nature of the environment. The drawing includes structural elements indicating the scale of the industrial setting, with an emphasis on mechanical complexity and human effort.

artworks.title: Making War Locomotives
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a train station scene. It includes a steam locomotive marked "U.S.A. 3122," a grand station interior with arched windows and chandeliers, and various individuals in motion. The drawing conveys an industrial early 20th-century train travel atmosphere through shading and linework.

artworks.title: The Flying Locomotive
artworks.description: This is an image showing a locomotive inside an industrial warehouse. The scene is depicted in monochrome, featuring a large indoor space filled with machinery and locomotives. The drawing showcases detailed shading, providing texture to the walls, floor, and equipment in the setting. A large steam locomotive is being lifted or moved by a crane system, with beams of light entering from high windows, emphasizing the industrial atmosphere of the space.

artworks.title: The Gun-Testing Ground
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an industrial scene with artillery and machinery. The image shows a detailed view of a large industrial facility or construction site focused on the assembly or maintenance of artillery pieces. The scene includes large cannons, gantries, cranes, rocky cliffs, and foliage. The lower section of the image shows intricate depictions of heavy machinery components like wheels, gears, and gun barrels. The elements are sketched with strong line work and contrast, emphasizing depth and complexity. The style of the drawing is detailed and technical.

artworks.title: The Iron Gate, Charleroi
artworks.description: The image displays an industrial scene from a direct frontal viewpoint. Railway tracks extend from the bottom of the image towards a distant horizon, with structures including a bridge with a latticework pattern obscuring the horizon. The brushstrokes in the image resemble etching or lithography, creating a textured effect. The color palette is monochromatic with contrasts of black and white, emphasizing the industrial theme. Smoking chimneys in the distance add to the industrial atmosphere conveyed through detailed line work.

artworks.title: The Great Chimney, the Motor Park
artworks.description: The image features a cityscape seen from an elevated viewpoint, with a river winding through an industrial area. On the left, there are structures or machinery, adding to the industrial feel. The horizon is high in the composition with smokestacks and buildings stretching into the distance. A tall smokestack dominates the skyline, emitting smoke into a cloudy sky. The painting style includes sketch-like brushstrokes, with quick lines and shading creating a hazy, slightly abstract representation of the industrial landscape. The monochromatic color scheme of black and white emphasizes the gritty texture of the scene, enhancing the industrial atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Canal at Blanzy, France
artworks.description: The image shows a view of a canal lined with tall trees. The horizon is low, with industrial structures in the distance emitting smoke. The brushstrokes are loose and dynamic, creating a monochromatic color palette of various shades of grey. The composition includes small buildings among the trees to the left.

artworks.title: Looking up the Cut from Bas Obispo
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a railway extending into the distance between hillsides. The horizon is high, with hills, vegetation, and a textured sky depicted. The brushstrokes are sketch-like, using black and white tones. Close to us, detailed vegetation contrasts with the railway. Farther away, the scene fades into lighter strokes, leading to hills in the background. The color palette emphasizes contrast and line work over color.

artworks.title: Eleusis, the Pavement of the Temple
artworks.description: The image is a black and white drawing depicting a scene featuring ruins. There are stone columns, structures, and horizontal steps leading into the composition. The sky dominates the image with swirling clouds. The brushstrokes are deliberate, creating texture on rocky formations and architectural elements. Distant mountains are visible against the sky. The color palette is monochrome, focusing on light and shadow contrast. A tall rocky outcrop is on the right side of the image.

artworks.title: Steam Shovel at Work in Culebra Cut
artworks.description: The image depicts an industrial site with a railway track, construction materials, and large machinery resembling a crane or excavator. Smoke is billowing from the machinery. There are rock formations and vegetation to the left. In the distance, a train travels along the tracks on a ridgeline, emitting smoke. The brushstrokes are dynamic, with broad sweeps and cross-hatching, creating an impressionistic feel. The color palette is monochromatic, using varying shades of black and gray to convey depth and texture.

artworks.title: At the Bottom of Gatun Lock
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large industrial shipyard or construction site. The scene features towering structures such as ship hulls or steel frameworks, creating a narrow passage. Railway tracks extend into the distance, indicating activity. Strong vertical and horizontal lines convey scale and perspective. Small sketchy figures occupy various levels of the construction. Dark shadows contrast with the lighter central passage, emphasizing vertical space. The style emphasizes industrial power and architectural grandeur.

artworks.title: Coal Mines, Monceau, France
artworks.description: The image depicts a black and white sketch showing a scene with a barge or canal boat labeled "The Boussenards Chalons" with a figure on board. In the background, there is a canal with embankments and a figure walking on the water's edge. Trees and industrial structures, including chimneys and scaffolding, can be seen further back. The image is created using a loose and sketchy style with a mix of dark shading and lighter strokes defining the natural and man-made elements. The sketch uses a monochromatic palette of gray and black.

artworks.title: The Old and the New
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor filled with ships and marine activity as viewed from a dockside perspective. The horizon is obscured by ships and structures in the middle distance. Loose brushstrokes in shades of black and white create a sketch-like quality, emphasizing textures and shadows. A small boat is tied to a pier in the foreground, and a large ship or building extends into the water on the right. In the distance, faint silhouettes of larger ships and industrial elements like cranes are visible. The black and white palette lends a historic and atmospheric feel to the busy harbor scene.

artworks.title: Steam Shovel in the Cut at Bas Obispo
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a steam-powered shovel loading rocks onto a train. The drawing shows a large, mechanical steam shovel moving rubble. The shovel's arm is extended upwards, capturing a mass of dirt and rocks. Below, a train with multiple cars is lined up. The setting appears to be a mountainous or rocky area, with sloping terrain in the background. The drawing style uses strong lines and contrast to depict the machinery. The details emphasize the industrial power and mechanical prowess of the steam era.

artworks.title: The Cut from Culebra
artworks.description: The image shows a scene from an elevated perspective looking down into a valley or a construction site within a mountainous landscape. The composition features steep hills or mountains on both sides, with intricate linework creating texture and depth in black and white. In the foreground, there are railway tracks with a steam engine and construction materials, while in the distance, the tracks lead towards the hills. Swirling clouds or smoke fill the sky, and the overall color palette is monochromatic with dark lines and lighter areas creating contrasts.

artworks.title: Old Million Eyes
artworks.description: The image shows an array of large industrial buildings dominating the scene, with a grid-like pattern created by intersecting lines of their framework. The horizon is obscured by the tall buildings and distant mountainous forms. The brushstrokes are expressive and cross-hatched, lending a dramatic quality to the scene. The color palette is primarily black and white, creating a moody contrast between the dark buildings and light sky. The immediate foreground is rugged, leading up to the structures, while the background features mountainous terrain.

artworks.title: Valley of Desolation
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a narrow river winding from the foreground to barren mountains and rock formations at the horizon. Stark trees are scattered throughout the scene, with rough and expressive brushwork conveying texture and movement. A monochromatic color palette of black, white, and gray enhances the dramatic visual impact of the natural environment.

artworks.title: The Big Mill, Gary, Indiana
artworks.description: The image shows an industrial scene with numerous steel mill structures dominating the skyline. A central blast furnace releases steam and smoke. The image features fine, detailed brushstrokes depicting metal textures in shades of gray and black. Train tracks curve towards the mill, leading the eye to a tunnel in the distance. Smoke fills the sky, blending with clouds in the background.

artworks.title: Offical Ancon
artworks.description: The drawing depicts an elevated view of a tropical landscape with a seaside village. Traditional buildings are surrounded by lush vegetation, including various trees with delicate, flowing lines for leaves. A hill with a lighthouse and a distant large structure are also visible. The sky is filled with fluffy clouds rendered in gentle, light strokes. The composition consists of fine, precise linear strokes defining natural and man-made elements. The color palette is monochrome, emphasizing details and creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Columns of Castor and Pollux, Girgenti
artworks.description: The image shows the remains of ancient columns and a segment of an entablature from a slightly elevated angle. The perspective allows the viewer to look up at the structure against the sky. The horizon line is not distinct, and the landscape extends beyond the columns, with rolling hills and clusters of trees creating depth. The brushstrokes are detailed and meticulous, with heavy shading giving a weathered appearance to the stone. The monochromatic palette emphasizes the contrast between the ruins and the softer background, focusing on the intricate rendering of the columns closest to us.

artworks.title: Shenandoah
artworks.description: The image depicts an industrial landscape with a muddy dual-track path leading towards factory buildings and smokestacks emitting dark smoke. The horizon is partially obscured by the buildings. The scene features energetic brushstrokes creating texture and movement, with a color palette of gray, black, and white. Utility poles line the path toward figures and machinery, while rugged terrain on the left adds to the industrial setting. More factory buildings and smokestacks are visible in the distance.
